english.note: Use this colloquial expression when someone takes off their clothes.
Use this casual alternative when emphasizing stripping off a garment.

examples.english: It's so hot that I strip off my clothes as soon as I get home.
examples.traditional: 天氣咁熱，我一返到屋企就剝衫。
examples.jyutping: tin1 hei3 gam3 jit6 ngo5 jat1 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5 zau6 mok1 saam1

examples.english: After playing football, I immediately undress because I’m covered in sweat.
examples.traditional: 踢完波我即刻剝衫，成身都係汗。
examples.jyutping: tek3 jyun4 bo1 ngo5 zik1 hak1 mok1 saam1 sing4 san1 dou1 hai6 hon6
